 SSC JE 2026 city slip out; scribe OTR by October 27
 Vaishnavi Shukla | October 24, 2026 | 11:40 AM IST | 2 mins read
 SSC JE 2026: Candidates appearing for the junior engineer exam can download the city slip and admit card from the official website at ssc.gov.in through login; Exams from November 2 to 6

 Subscribe Now SSC JE 2026 admit card will be issued 2-3 days prior to exam date. (Representative Image: Careers360)  The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has issued the SSC Junior Engineer (JE) city exam slip 2026. Candidates appearing for the SSC JE 2026 exam can download the city slip and admit card from the official website at ssc.gov.in.
 Candidates can download SSC JE city details by logging in through the candidate login using their credentials. The SSC JE admit card 2026 will be available for download 2-3 days before the respective examination date.
 According to the SSC notice, the candidates availing the ‘Own Scribe’ facility are required to do fresh scribe registration on the commission’s website. 
 SSC has now integrated scribe registration with Aadhaar authentication; therefore, all persons willing to appear as a scribe must complete fresh registration. 
 Candidates who have opted for ‘own scribe’ will be able to map their scribe OTR by October 27, and the scribe entry pass will be generated only for those candidates who successfully map their scribe OTR. 
 Also read UPSC, SSC Exams: Government job seekers demand students’ panel, tight monitoring in appeal to commission, DoPT 
 SSC JE 2026 papers
 Candidates must note that the SSC JE 2026 exam will be conducted for six specific listed papers, including general engineering in the disciplines of civil and structural, electrical and mechanical engineering, and for IMD scientific assistant (SA) in the disciplines of computer science and information technology, electronics and telecommunication engineering and physics from November 2 to 6. 
 The exam for the post of JE (telecommunication) will be held from November 30 to December 1, for which the city slip and admit card will be issued 8-10 days in advance. 
 Candidates who opted for the post of JE telecommunication paper were also eligible to apply for electrical and scientific assistant (SA). For such candidates who have opted for SA paper can also choose consider EC/TC as the default subject. However, candidates wishing to change their subject to CS/IT or physics may do so during the exam city slip, which will remain open until October 27 at 11 pm.
